observations:

  [Package 1: good] — The supernal heart IS the Book of Remembrance; yearning IS learning
  ↑ (causal source: two tzaddikim conversing at a distance compose this book)
  ↓ (causal consequence: God hears only, writes it as the Book of Remembrance, available to yearning souls)

  - 'צוּר לְבָבִי' and 'נְדִיב לֵב' are attribute-names for the quality of heart-longing that Package 1 is about. They extend the package's node set but do not define a new domain.

The 3-node threshold for new package creation is not reached by any conceptual domain other than Package 1.

There is no evil mirror domain in this Torah. The teaching makes no mention of opposition, obstruction, or a dark counterpart to the heart-book mechanism. It is a purely positive, consolatory teaching.

Conclusion: Torah #142 yields exactly 1 package, 4 dataset nodes, 4 proposed additions (all assigned to Package 1), 0 new packages needed.
